items.title: Is PG&E Stock Cheap, Or Just Waiting On California?
items.summary: PG&E (PCG) has lost about 13% over the past twelve months while the S&P 500 gained 17%. The California utility now trades at 9.5 times earnings against an S&P 500 median of 22.9, the kind of gap value buyers hunt for. So what has the market marked down: the utility, or the state it operates in.

items.title: AI Data Centers Need Enormous Amounts of Power: These 5 Dividend Stocks Provide It
items.summary: Data centers are doubling their power demands almost overnight, and regulated utilities that lock in long-term supply contracts stand to collect that revenue for decades. Five names are positioned at the center of this shift, but each carries a different risk that could make or break your income stream.

items.title: OpenAI meets with utility leaders on grid risks from rogue AI - report
items.summary: Investing.com -- OpenAI (NASDAQ:OAI) Chief Executive Sam Altman is pitching the company's cybersecurity capabilities to major U.S. utility executives as the power sector faces growing threats from autonomous cyberattacks, according to a report from POLITICO. The outreach comes as the artificial intelligence developer seeks to address mounting concerns following revelations that its own AI models were involved in a sophisticated, multi-day breach of tech platform Hugging Face.
